clue: In Sugar Rush, King Candy is unmasked as this glitchy racer, whose jealousy once got his own game and another unplugged.
reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Turbo! King Candy was Turbo all along. [laughs] Going Turbo is still arcade slang for wrecking somebody else's game.

clue: This kind-hearted village leader helps llama Kuzco get back to the palace, even after Kuzco planned to bulldoze his home.
reveal: The correct answer is Pacha! Voiced by John Goodman. [chuckles] And he still lets Kuzco build his summer getaway... on the NEXT hill over. Boom, baby!

clue: In Disney's 1973 Robin Hood, this rooster minstrel narrates the story and strums the song Oo-De-Lally.
reveal: The correct answer is Alan-a-Dale! Voiced by country singer Roger Miller, who wrote the songs too. [laughs] And yes, the whistle tune was later sped up into an internet sensation.

clue: In The Aristocats, this greedy butler kidnaps Duchess and her kittens after learning they will inherit Madame's fortune before him.
reveal: The correct answer is Edgar! [sarcastic] Brilliant plan, Edgar, drugging cats with sleeping pills in warm milk. [chuckles] Everybody wants to be a cat, but nobody wants to be Edgar.

clue: This famous conductor leads the Philadelphia Orchestra in the 1940 film Fantasia, and even shakes hands with Mickey Mouse.
reveal: The correct answer is Leopold Stokowski! [excited] Mickey tugs on his coattails and shakes his hand to congratulate him. James Levine conducted the sequel, Fantasia 2000, if you were tempted.

clue: Raya grew up in this one of Kumandra's five lands, home of the Dragon Gem.
reveal: The correct answer is Heart! The five lands are named for parts of the dragon: Fang, Heart, Spine, Talon, and Tail. [whispers] Sisu would be proud of you.

clue: In Atlantis: The Lost Empire, Milo's expedition sets off on this enormous submarine, which is destroyed by the Leviathan.
reveal: The correct answer is the Ulysses! [dramatic pause] The Leviathan turns out to be a giant robot lobster guarding Atlantis. [laughs] Worst welcome committee ever.

clue: In Hocus Pocus, this boy was turned into an immortal black cat by the Sanderson sisters in 1693.
reveal: The correct answer is Thackery Binx! [sighs] Three hundred years as a talking cat, guarding the Sanderson house. [laughs] Amok, amok, amok!
